title: Matrix stored in memory
statement: For an $n$-by-$k$ integer matrix $A$, a memory function $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, and a starting address $a$, say that $A$ is stored at $a$ in row-major order when $\mu(a+ik+j)=A_{ij}$ for every row $i<n$ and column $j<k$.
